title: CLI device authorization session create request
description: Provider identity scope configuration MUST define non-empty allowed and default scope lists containing non-empty strings without surrounding whitespace, unique within each list, with every default scope present in the allowed list. Malformed, duplicate, empty, whitespace-padded, or unsupported configured scopes MUST fail closed at startup and request time instead of being normalized or deduplicated. Every configured scope MUST contain only Unicode scalar values; unpaired UTF-16 surrogate escapes MUST fail closed at startup and request time before session creation or persistence access. CLI session metadata fields cli_name, cli_version, hostname, and key_name MUST contain only Unicode scalar values. Unpaired UTF-16 surrogate escapes MUST fail closed before identity verification, provisional session insertion, API-key insertion, session mutation, or persistence access; providers MUST NOT rely on lossy UTF-8 replacement during persistence or replay comparison.

cli_name.description: CLI metadata values MUST be non-empty strings without surrounding whitespace, ASCII control characters, or Unicode bidirectional formatting controls. Empty, whitespace-only, whitespace-padded, control-bearing, or bidirectional-control-bearing values MUST fail closed before identity verification, provisional session insertion, API-key insertion, session mutation, or persistence access; providers MUST NOT trim or sanitize caller input.
